notes: Multiple pins, tasks and events, each with its own name, message, alarm sound and vibration setting. Choose entry or exit, a 10-5000 m distance, once-only or repeat visits, weekdays, an optional date and a local time window. Overnight windows are supported. Complete and reopen tasks; overlapping alarms play in order and survive reopening. Your saved mailbox is retained as a 50 m task. Add a reminder from the home screen or by holding on the map. Includes in-app updates and live GPS accuracy in Settings.
